text:
priya_cs: Hey team, CatalystAI asked for a temporary rate bump and IP allowlist for an upcoming LATAM launch next week. They want +3x token RPS for 72h starting 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC and allowlist for two CIDR blocks.
noah_se: Got it. Do they need region enablement (latam region) or just routing to existing us-east with higher quota?
priya_cs: They prefer routing to a new LATAM edge if possible, but will accept us-east with reduced latency SLO. Priority is the rate window + allowlist so their demo doesn't get throttled. Also flagged that renewal is in ~32 days — they'd like an enablement call during the burst.
jasper_sre: Can we do the 3x RPS window from a Dedicated perspective? If they're on Hosted, we can set a temporary policy. Need their org id and the two CIDRs.
priya_cs: Org ID: org-0catalyst. CIDRs: 200.45.120.0/22 and 2803:afc0::/48 (they use dual-stack).
noah_se: 2803... is that valid formatting? IPv6 looks okay. I'll validate. Also suggest adding a short TTL for the allowlist change (auto-remove after 96h) per security.
priya_cs: Yes please auto-remove. Catalyst asked for auto-revoke after 96h. I'll confirm the exact start time; they said midnight UTC on the 2nd.
deploy-bot: REQUEST RECEIVED: change_request_id=CR-6321 | owner=noah_se | status=pending-approval
jasper_sre: Workflow: I'll stage a temporary route policy + allowlist entry in staging, run a smoke test, then promote. Steps (short):
```
# stage allowlist
POST /api/v1/allowlists 
{ "org": "org-0catalyst", "cidrs": ["200.45.120.0/22","2803:afc0::/48"], "expires_at": "2026-04-06T00:00:00Z" }
# create temporary rate policy
POST /api/v1/rate-policies 
{ "org": "org-0catalyst", "multiplier": 3, "window_seconds": 259200, "start_at": "2026-04-02T00:00:00Z" }
```
noah_se: I'll pair with Jasper on the staging tests. Security ok with auto-remove?
priya_cs: Security approved verbally; I'll get a follow-up signed email from Catalyst for audit. Also can we schedule the 45-min renewal/enablement call for 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC? They want a walkthrough of caching and batching tips to avoid further bursts.
jasper_sre: Tentative — I'll add the calendar invite after we confirm policy changes. No blockers from infra.
noah_se: Quick note: will add a traffic tag so we can track cost delta for the renewal conversation: tag=catalyst-latam-burst.
priya_cs: Thanks — I'll CC billing and the account exec. Catalina from the customer will send the signed email ASAP. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CHANGE_SCHEDULED: CR-6321 scheduled for 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z | notify:@priya_cs,@noah_se,@jasper_sre
priya_cs: Awesome. If anything flares during the window we'll escalate in #eng-oncall. Closing here once the signed email lands.
